title: CHOCOLATE ALMONDS
ingredients: 1/2 pound cake of Walter Baker's Vanilla Sweet Chocolate,
instructions: Blanch the almonds by pouring boiling water on them, and let them stand two or three minutes. Roast them in oven. Dip them in the following recipe for chocolate coating, and drop on paraffine paper.
Put chocolate in small saucepan over boiling water and when melted stir in butter and water. Mix well. If found to be too thick, add more water; if too thin, more chocolate.
